title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-23 02:13:51 最新章节：第143章 回归现实八种奖励
content_zh:
2046年6月1日，中午。
此时，蓝星上至少十亿人都在抬头望天。
在天穹深处，有三处光团，好似湖面水波，又如星空之门，乌云遮不住，雷电贯不穿。
整整出现了一年。
中午十二点。
霎时间，一道道流光从三个巨大的光团中出现，降落世界各地。
细细数来，却只有二十八道。
这个数字让全世界哗然。
平阳市的林凡也不例外。
他正在文化路上的一家面馆前，准备等结果出来后好吃午饭，可这个数字，让他脸色都是一变。
与此同时，天穹上降临一道恢弘神音，响彻全球，回荡在每一个人耳边，传至脑海，烙印在神魂中。
【第一轮游戏结束】
【三天后将会开启五个新副本】
【现在挑选八千人，三天后全部强制征召进入游戏世界】
声音戛然而止。
“八千人，希望能选中我吧！”
林凡暗自祈祷，正要走进面馆，却脚步一顿。
他感觉手心发热，摊开一看，掌心出现了一个金色五角星。
同时心中也涌出了一道信息：你被选为降临者，三天后前往游戏世界。
他连忙握紧。

嘴角弯起一抹弧度。
“老板，大碗烩面。”
林凡走进店中，叫了一声，拿出手机付了十二元。
找个空位坐下，听着陆陆续续走进来的其他人的议论声，他的思绪回到了以前。
他是穿越客，还是胎穿。
这个世界与前世类似却又不同。
明朝朱棣靖难登基，养民生息的同时，也大力发展工业，然后横扫全球，建立日不落帝国。
不接受的和看不顺眼的，全都填海喂鱼。
至此，蓝星归一。
继始皇帝之后，明朝再次统一文字、货币、思想和度量衡。
明朝末期，朝廷腐败，贪污横行，民不聊生，最终被推翻了统治，建立现代社会国家。
也因为这个关系，林凡对这个世界既熟悉又陌生。
content_en:
June 1, 2046, noon.
At this time, at least one billion people on Blue Star were looking up at the sky.
Deep in the sky, there are three light groups, which are like water waves on the lake, and like gates to the starry sky, which cannot be covered by dark clouds and cannot be penetrated by thunder and lightning.
It appeared for a whole year.
Twelve noon.
In an instant, streams of light appeared from three huge light groups and landed all over the world.
Counting it carefully, there are only twenty-eight.
This number caused an uproar around the world.
Lin Fan from Pingyang City is no exception.
He was in front of a noodle shop on Wenhua Road, preparing to have lunch after the results came out, but this number made his expression change.
At the same time, a majestic divine sound descended from the sky, resounding throughout the world, echoing in everyone's ears, reaching their minds, and being imprinted on their souls.
[End of the first round of the game]
[Five new copies will be opened in three days]
[Select 8,000 people now, and all of them will be forcibly recruited into the game world in three days]
The sound stopped suddenly.
"Eight thousand people, I hope they can choose me!"
Lin Fan prayed secretly and was about to walk into the noodle shop when he stopped.
He felt his palms getting warm, and when he opened them, a golden five-pointed star appeared in his palms.
At the same time, a message came out of my heart: You are selected as the descendant and will go to the game world in three days.
He quickly tightened his grip.
The corners of his mouth curved.
"Boss, a big bowl of braised noodles."
Lin Fan walked into the store, called out, took out his mobile phone and paid twelve yuan.
He found an empty seat and sat down, listening to the chatter of other people who came in one after another, and his thoughts returned to the past.
He is a time traveler, or a transmigration traveler.
This world is similar but different from the previous life.
In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Di Jingnan ascended the throne. While supporting the people, he also vigorously developed industry, and then swept across the world to establish an empire on which the sun never sets.
Those who don't accept it and those who don't like it will fill the sea and feed it to fish.
At this point, Blue Star is unified.
After the First Emperor, the Ming Dynasty once again unified writing, currency, ideas, and weights and measures.
At the end of the Ming Dynasty, the court was corrupt, corruption was rampant, and the people were in dire straits. The rule was eventually overthrown and a modern social country was established.
Because of this relationship, Lin Fan is both familiar and unfamiliar with this world.
